findings.problem: The example has no conjugated verb, and as an exclamation it should have ¡ ! instead of a full stop.
findings.fix: example.es: Este libro es muy interesante. / example.en: This book is very interesting.

note: If the editor wants to keep the exclamation, "¡Qué libro tan interesante!" is natural, but it still has no conjugated verb.
